post.title: Concurrency Models: Actor Model vs. Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP)
post.subtitle: An in-depth mathematical and practical comparison of the Actor Model and CSP concurrency patterns in Java.
post.brief: Shared-memory multithreading using manual locks is notoriously difficult to scale and debug. To avoid race conditions and deadlocks, modern platforms use message-passing concurrency models. This guide compares the Actor Model (used in Erlang and Akka/Pekko) with Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP, used in Go) and provides full Java implementations for both.
